proposed_widenings.name: DcSource.fixed
proposed_widenings.justification: The item casts an existing spell but overrides its save DC to a fixed value. The current surface can express caster-derived, weapon-derived, and innate ability DCs, but not an item-specified fixed DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast Lightning Bolt (save DC 15) from it

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items currently record only a boolean attunement flag. This item further restricts attunement eligibility to spellcasters, which cannot be expressed without losing a real rule on the record.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because the honest encoding needs a fixed save DC for an item-cast spell. Reusing grant_spell_access.charge_cast would silently inherit Lightning Bolt's caster_spell_save_dc, which is false for this item. Secondary omission: the attunement-by-a-spellcaster restriction is also not representable.
